readings: For every customer, sum their Invoice.Total values, using zero for customers with no invoices. Divide each customer’s total by the sum of all customers’ totals to get their revenue share. Compute the average share across all customers, then keep customers whose share is greater than that average. Return one row containing the average customer total for the kept customers, their average share, and the average of each kept customer’s share minus the overall average share. Do not round.

For every customer, sum their Invoice.Total values, using zero for customers with no invoices. Divide each customer’s total by the sum of all customers’ totals to get their revenue share. Compute the average share across all customers, then keep customers whose share is greater than that average. Return one row containing the average customer total for the kept customers, their average share, and the average relative excess of their shares over the overall average share, calculated as (customer share − overall average share) / overall average share. Do not round.
queries:
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS customer_total
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
customer_shares AS (
    SELECT customer_total,
           1.0 * customer_total / SUM(customer_total) OVER () AS share
    FROM customer_totals
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS overall_average_share
    FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.customer_total) AS average_customer_total,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.share - a.overall_average_share) AS average_share_above_overall
FROM customer_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE cs.share > a.overall_average_share

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS customer_total
    FROM Customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
),
customer_shares AS (
    SELECT customer_total,
           1.0 * customer_total / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(customer_total) FROM customer_totals), 0) AS share
    FROM customer_totals
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.customer_total) AS average_customer_total,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG((cs.share - oa.average_share) / oa.average_share) AS average_relative_excess
FROM customer_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.share > oa.average_share
